title: Spec-CoFrGeNet: Reparametrizing Continued Fraction Networks for Stable and Accurate Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.32041v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continued fractions have been shown to be a function class capable of constructing expressive yet parameter-efficient neural networks. These neural networks are not only effective for supervised learning, but also for training LLMs. However, the rational form of this function class introduces poles when the denominator approaches zero, which prior work has avoided by enforcing a small positive (non-smooth) lower bound. We show that performance and training stability can be highly sensitive to the choice of this lower bound. In this work, we introduce a novel transformation of the partial denominators, inspired by its connection to the Green's function in physics, that mitigates the above issue elegantly by constraining the spectra of the constructed tridiagonal Hamiltonian. translated_title: Spec-CoFrGeNet：通过重参数化连分数网络实现稳定且精确的训练
translated_abstract: 连分数已被证明是一种能够构建表达能力强且参数高效的神经网络的函数类。这类神经网络不仅在监督学习中有效，还可用于训练大型语言模型（LLM）。然而，该函数类的有理形式在分母趋近于零时会引入极点，以往的工作通过强制施加一个较小的正数（非平滑）下界来避免这一问题。我们证明，性能和训练稳定性对该下界的选择可能高度敏感。在这项工作中，我们受该函数与物理学中格林函数联系的启发，引入了一种对部分分母的新型变换，通过约束所构造的三对角哈密顿量的谱，优雅地缓解了上述问题。我们的方法还进一步消除了以往工作为保持稳定性而采用的增量式训练，从而避免了繁琐的标准预训练过程修改。
tldr: 该论文提出Spec-CoFrGeNet，通过受格林函数启发对部分分母进行变换以约束三对角哈密顿量的谱，从而解决连分数网络因分母趋零产生极点导致的训练不稳定问题，无需下界约束和增量式训练即可实现稳定且精确的训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Spec-CoFrGeNet, which reparametrizes continued fraction networks via a Green's function-inspired transformation of partial denominators that constrains the spectra of the tridiagonal Hamiltonian, eliminating poles from vanishing denominators and enabling stable and accurate training without lower bounds or incremental training.
